noticias.titulo: Conitec opens Public Consultation 109/2026 on odevixibat for progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis
noticias.resumen: Conitec opened Public Consultation 109/2026 on November 13, running until December 2, 2026, on whether to add odevixibat to the SUS for progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC). It joins CP 108/2026, which covers the same drug for cholestatic pruritus in Alagille syndrome and closes November 30. The preliminary technical report is published on Conitec's open-consultations page.
noticias.accion: Pediatric hepatology centers, patient groups and the manufacturer should read the preliminary report and comment by December 2.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA orders recall of tirzepatide and retatrutide APIs held by importer Condor
noticias.resumen: Resolution RE 4.422/2026, published in the DOU on November 12, orders the recall of tirzepatide API lot 20241030 and all retatrutide API lots stored by Condor Importador & Operador Logistico Ltda, and suspends their sale, distribution and use. ANVISA found that the storage site did not meet the conservation requirements of RDC 654/2022. It also noted that retatrutide is an experimental drug with no registration anywhere, so importing or selling it as a pharmaceutical input is not allowed. The inputs were meant for compounding pharmacies.
noticias.accion: Compounding pharmacies and clinics should check their inventories and suppliers for these inputs, quarantine any affected material and stop dispensing retatrutide-based preparations.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA bans Needs dermoprotective oily lotion and orders recall of all lots
noticias.resumen: Resolution RE 4.414/2026, published in the DOU on November 12, bans the manufacture, sale, distribution, advertising and use of Needs Locao Oleosa Dermoprotetora, made by Greenwood Industria e Comercio Ltda and sold as an RD Saude own brand, and orders a recall of all lots. The product had no valid sanitary registration, and its label made therapeutic claims, such as wound healing, skin regeneration and bedsore prevention, that are not allowed for cosmetics. ANVISA described the measure as preventive and did not report contamination.
noticias.accion: Clinics, home-care providers and long-term care facilities should remove this lotion from wound and pressure-injury care stocks and use registered products instead.

noticias.titulo: Brazil adds eplerenone to the SUS for heart failure patients who cannot tolerate spironolactone
noticias.resumen: Portaria SCTIE/MS No. 74, dated November 10 and made official on November 12, adds eplerenone to the SUS for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, NYHA classes II to IV, in patients intolerant to spironolactone and under the Ministry's clinical protocol. The SUS has up to 180 days to make the drug available.
noticias.accion: Eplerenone suppliers and distributors should prepare for SUS procurement over the next 180 days.

noticias.titulo: Hapvida sells Hospital Octaviano Neves properties in Belo Horizonte to Feluma for R$ 60 million
noticias.resumen: In a market notice on November 11, Hapvida said its subsidiary signed a promise to sell the properties of Hospital Octaviano Neves in Belo Horizonte to Fundacao Educacional Lucas Machado (Feluma) for R$ 60 million, with 20% paid at signing and the rest due at closing in early 2027. Hapvida is moving the hospital's services to its own Belo Horizonte network as part of a portfolio optimization. According to Moon BH, Feluma plans a university hospital unit focused on the SUS, with 250 beds, 12 of them ICU, and 70 hemodialysis stations, and estimates R$ 40 million in renovation work.
noticias.accion: Equipment and supply distributors in Minas Gerais should track Feluma's fit-out of the new unit, including ICU and hemodialysis, as a procurement opportunity in 2027.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA bans supplements from four brands, including suspected counterfeits
noticias.resumen: Resolutions RE 4,406 and 4,407, published in the DOU on November 10, ban all lots of W Nutry and Vittacaps supplements and Muuh Magic bovine colostrum, plus lot L75F0001 of Essential Nutrition Kit 3 Ômega Core. Reasons include missing sanitary notification, unauthorized health claims and products whose named manufacturers do not recognize them.
noticias.accion: Pharmacies and distributors should pull these products and lots from shelves and online listings now.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA registers two more semaglutide pens, bringing 2026 GLP-1 pen registrations to 22
noticias.resumen: Under RE 4.411/2026, ANVISA registered two injectable semaglutide products from Ávita Care: a generic and the similar product Loryvia, both for adults with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes. This brings GLP-1 pen registrations in 2026 to 22, helped by a prioritization the Ministry of Health requested for the SUS.
noticias.accion: Distributors and clinics should expect more competition and lower prices in GLP-1 pens and update supplier and formulary lists.

noticias.titulo: Fleury and a Bradsaúde unit set up FleuryOnco oncology venture with R$ 72 million
noticias.resumen: Fleury and Hospitais da Atlântica, indirectly controlled by Bradsaúde, created FleuryOnco with an initial investment of R$ 72 million; Fleury holds 50.1%. The company will offer oncology therapies, multidisciplinary support and clinical research under the Fleury Oncologia and Onco One brands, and plans seven units by the end of 2027.
noticias.accion: Suppliers of oncology drugs, infusion equipment and diagnostics should treat FleuryOnco as a new purchasing account through 2027.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA bans the unregistered weight-loss product Ultra Shape and orders all lots seized
noticias.resumen: A resolution published in the Diário Oficial da União on November 9 fully bans Ultra Shape, a weight-loss product with no ANVISA registration, notification or listing, and orders all lots seized. The manufacturer could not be identified. The ban covers manufacturing, sale, distribution, advertising and use.
noticias.accion: Pharmacies, distributors and clinics should check stock and sales channels, pull any Ultra Shape units and stop advertising it.

noticias.titulo: Field alert 5378: some Vitros A1c slide lots may overstate HbA1c results
noticias.resumen: ANVISA published technovigilance alert 5378 on Vitros Chemistry Products A1c Slides (registration 81246986861). Certain lot generations may give positively biased glycated hemoglobin results; under field action TC2026-224, Ortho Clinical Diagnostics do Brasil tells labs to stop using them, discard the stock and return the acknowledgment form for credit or replacement. The product was distributed in 19 states.
noticias.accion: Labs and distributors should check Vitros A1c stock this week, discard affected generations, return the acknowledgment form and report events in Notivisa.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA seizes two Trodelvy lots made for Turkey and a paracetamol IV lot is recalled
noticias.resumen: ANVISA ordered the seizure of Trodelvy (Gilead) lots 10008806 and 10008808, which were made only for the Turkish market and differ from the original product, and banned their sale, distribution and use. In the same measures (RE 4.355 and RE 4.387/2026), Halex Istar is voluntarily recalling Halexminophen 10 mg/mL IV infusion, lot 0000216652, for a packaging quality defect.
noticias.accion: Oncology clinics, hospital pharmacies and distributors should check stock for those lots now, quarantine any units and buy only through authorized channels.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA opens a call to fast-track up to eight dossiers for active ingredients made in Brazil
noticias.resumen: ANVISA will select up to eight dossiers for active pharmaceutical ingredients made in Brazil and evaluate them for a CADIFA (dossier adequacy letter). At least the final synthesis step must take place in Brazil and the manufacturer must hold a valid ANVISA GMP certificate. Companies have 60 calendar days from publication to apply, with reviews planned throughout 2027.
noticias.accion: Local API makers and the drug companies they supply should check the notice's list and apply within the 60-day window.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit Mounjaro (tirzepatide) lots banned and seized
noticias.resumen: ANVISA Resolution 4,329/2026, published on November 6, bans sale, distribution and use and orders seizure of five counterfeit Mounjaro lots reported by Eli Lilly: 2.5 mg KUSTR43969410, 5 mg B55010 and 15 mg D810042, D838889 and 2138737. Legitimate Mounjaro bought through regular channels remains authorized.
noticias.accion: Check tirzepatide stock against these five lot numbers and buy only from Lilly-authorized distributors.

noticias.titulo: Conitec consultations open on vutrisiran and odevixibat for the SUS
noticias.resumen: Conitec has two open public consultations on SUS incorporation: CP 107/2026 on vutrisiran for stage I hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis with polyneuropathy (closes November 17) and CP 108/2026 on odevixibat for cholestatic pruritus in Alagille syndrome (published in the DOU on November 6, open November 9 to 30).
noticias.accion: Companies and specialists with evidence on these drugs should submit contributions before the deadlines.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA approves oral Wegovy, Brazil's first GLP-1 tablet for obesity
noticias.resumen: Resolução-RE No. 4.249/2026 approves Novo Nordisk's once-daily oral semaglutide for adults with obesity (BMI 30 or more) or BMI 27 to under 30 with a weight-related comorbidity, titrated from 1.5 mg to a 25 mg maintenance dose. No launch date or price has been announced.
noticias.accion: Distributors, pharmacies and obesity clinics should plan stock and patient guidance for the oral form.

noticias.titulo: Conitec's 157th meeting reviews wider PET scan use, transplants and cancer drugs for the SUS
noticias.resumen: At its 157th meeting on November 4-6, Conitec reviewed wider PET scan use for high-risk melanoma and unrelated-donor and allogeneic stem cell transplants, plus drugs including teprotumumab, durvalumab, brentuximab vedotin, ribociclib and immunoglobulins. Initial recommendations will go to public consultation.
noticias.accion: Imaging providers, transplant centers and the companies concerned should watch for the resulting public consultations and prepare input.

noticias.titulo: BNDES lends R$ 285 million to Eurofarma for new-drug R&D
noticias.resumen: BNDES approved R$ 285 million under its Mais Inovação program for Eurofarma's research plan, covering opioid-replacement pain treatments, an antibiotic for resistant microorganisms and new combinations for depression and Alzheimer's drugs. Part of the funds goes to clinical trials and seven imported lab devices for its Itapevi R&D center; BNDES says it has approved R$ 11.7 billion for health since 2023.
noticias.accion: Suppliers of lab equipment and clinical-research services should watch for Eurofarma tenders tied to this plan.

noticias.titulo: ANS rejects cardiac contractility modulation device for health plan coverage and opens consultation on two cancer drugs
noticias.resumen: On November 3, the ANS board unanimously issued a final unfavorable recommendation on cardiac contractility modulation for refractory chronic heart failure. That ends the device's current assessment cycle, so it will not join the mandatory coverage list (Rol) in this update. ANS cited evidence from a single randomized trial of about 160 patients and an estimated incremental budget impact of about R$ 72 million per year. The board also opened a public consultation, running November 6 to 25, on its preliminary unfavorable recommendations for lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab (advanced clear-cell kidney cancer) and ivosidenib (IDH1-mutated cholangiocarcinoma), with a public hearing on November 16.
noticias.accion: Device and drug makers affected should plan market access without Rol coverage for these technologies, and anyone wanting to contest the recommendations should take part in the November 16 hearing or comment by November 25.

noticias.titulo: Health plans must now cover cholangioscopy with laser or electrohydraulic lithotripsy for complex bile duct stones
noticias.resumen: Since November 3, 2026, Brazilian health plans must cover cholangioscopy with laser or electrohydraulic lithotripsy for patients whose bile duct stones could not be treated by ERCP. The ANS board approved the addition to the Rol on October 2, after a public consultation and technical meetings. The change should increase demand for cholangioscopes, lithotripsy probes and related consumables in private hospitals.
noticias.accion: Endoscopy device distributors and hospitals should review stock, pricing and plan contracts for cholangioscopy and lithotripsy kits now that coverage is mandatory.

noticias.titulo: Superficial radiotherapy device WCR banned after manufacturing inspection
noticias.resumen: Resolutions RE 4,256/2026 and RE 4,262/2026 ban the manufacture, distribution, sale, use, advertising and storage of the WCR device used in superficial radiotherapy for skin cancer, distributed by Safe Life Distribuidora de Produtos para Saúde. The ban covers all batches made since September 16, after an inspection found the device was not produced under current sanitary rules.
noticias.accion: If your hospital or clinic uses or stocks WCR units, suspend use of the affected batches now and contact the distributor.

noticias.titulo: Partial interdiction at Port of Santos terminal for health products
noticias.resumen: Resolution RE 4,282/2026 bars Brasil Terminal Portuário (BTP) in Santos from receiving and storing temperature-sensitive medical devices and raw materials, medicines and pharmaceutical inputs, and controlled substances. Inspectors found no segregated area for suspect or interdicted goods and no locked area for controlled products. The measure stays in force until the failures are fixed.
noticias.accion: If you import health products through BTP, check with your freight forwarder whether shipments must be rerouted and plan for possible delays.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA registers five more generic GLP-1 pens
noticias.resumen: ANVISA published in the DOU the registration of five semaglutide or liraglutide injectable pens: Aribet, Lyrza and Wylovol (liraglutide, made by Biocon, registered by Farma Vision), Embeltah (semaglutide, Dr. Reddy's) and Sevema (semaglutide, Aché), both made by OneSource Specialty. That brings to 20 the GLP-1 pens registered in Brazil in 2026.
noticias.accion: Distributors and hospital pharmacies should expect more price competition in GLP-1s and review supplier lists.

noticias.organismo: Ministerio da Saude - Instancia Nacional de Etica em Pesquisa (Inaep)
noticias.titulo: Consultations open on a three-tier risk classification for human research ethics review
noticias.resumen: Inaep, part of the Ministry of Health, opened two public consultations on October 28. The first proposes classifying research involving human subjects as low, moderate or high risk, with ethics review scaled to each level, and new procedures for handling protocols and amendments in the national research ethics system (Sinep); comments close December 26, 2026. The second sets rules for appeals against decisions of research ethics committees and Inaep; comments close December 13, 2026.
noticias.accion: Sponsors, CROs and hospitals running device or drug trials should review the risk tiers and comment through the Brasil Participativo platform before the December deadlines.

noticias.titulo: Recall of Ringer's Lactate and two bevacizumab biosimilar lots
noticias.resumen: Resolution RE 4,231/2026 orders the recall and suspends sale and use of Ringer's Lactate 500 mL lot M 0465 26 (JP Indústria Farmacêutica), after dark particles were found in the bags, and of Simbeva lot BF25008896 (Teuto) and Abevmy lot BF26002105 (Biocon), after out-of-spec bacterial endotoxin results.
noticias.accion: Hospitals, clinics and distributors should check stock for these lots today and quarantine any affected units.

noticias.titulo: ANS Public Consultation 179 would change how health plans are suspended from selling; deadline December 7
noticias.resumen: ANS opened Public Consultation 179 to change the criteria of its Care Guarantee Monitoring, which uses complaints about missed deadlines and denied coverage. A medical-hospital operator would be flagged if its results are far worse than its peers' or worsen over two consecutive periods, and dental-only operators would no longer face temporary sales suspension in regular monitoring. Contributions are open until 7 December 2026.
noticias.accion: Providers and clinics that depend on health-plan volume should review the proposal and send contributions through the ANS portal before 7 December.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit Accu-Chek Active test strips banned
noticias.resumen: ANVISA banned the sale of counterfeit Accu-Chek Active blood glucose strips found in two Amazon listings. Roche identified strips with different features, no original outer packaging and the label "ONLY FOR GOVERNMENT TENDER". The products cannot be distributed, imported or used.
noticias.accion: If you sell glucose strips, buy only from authorized channels and check packaging against the original; report any suspicious stock.

noticias.titulo: Precautionary ban on a Fauldleuco (calcium folinate) lot
noticias.resumen: Resolution RE 4,150/2026 suspends lot 25D0808 of Fauldleuco (calcium folinate 10 mg/mL, made by Libbs) on suspicion of particulate matter. It must not be used or sold until tests confirm its safety.
noticias.accion: Hospitals and distributors should quarantine lot 25D0808 and check their stock today.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA publishes lists of recognized technical standards for devices
noticias.resumen: ANVISA will publish on its portal the technical standards it recognizes for medical devices, in three lists: cross-cutting standards, orthopedic implants and health-use materials. The lists will be updated continuously.
noticias.accion: Use the lists to align product development and registration dossiers with the standards ANVISA expects.

noticias.titulo: ANVISA regulatory sandbox rules open for comment until December 11
noticias.resumen: ANVISA opened Public Consultation 1.427/2026 on a draft RDC for its Regulatory Sandbox, covering governance, selection criteria, temporary authorization, monitoring and risk safeguards for innovative products, services and business models. The 60-day consultation closes on 11 December 2026.
noticias.accion: Medtech, SaMD and digital-health companies should read the draft and file comments before 11 December.

noticias.titulo: Field alert 5356: Edwards HemoSphere monitor cable labels
noticias.resumen: Edwards Lifesciences reported that on HemoSphere HEM1 advanced monitors (model HEMFSM10) made between June 2021 and June 2026, side labels may be missing or swapped, so left and right values may not match the cable labels.
noticias.accion: If you have these monitors, check that flag, sensor and channel labels match the box (A1 left, B2 right) and connect cables by the box labels; report issues in Notivisa citing alert 5356.

noticias.titulo: Field alert 5355: Bluetooth disconnections on Medtronic CareLink SmartSync
noticias.resumen: Auto Suture do Brasil (Medtronic) reported Bluetooth disconnections between the tablet and the CareLink SmartSync base station and patient connector (models 24967 and 24970A), which can corrupt data and cause loss of waveforms. Tablets on iPadOS 26.6 or 26.6.1 need no action; tablets must not be updated to iPadOS 27 until compatibility is confirmed.
noticias.accion: If you use SmartSync programmers, check the tablet OS version, hold iPadOS 27 updates and return the customer confirmation form to Medtronic.

noticias.titulo: Health plans must cover five new technologies from October 1
noticias.resumen: ANS added or expanded five items in the mandatory coverage list (Rol) for private health plans, effective October 1, 2026. They include the hormonal intrauterine system for endometriosis and ultrasound liver elastography for primary biliary cholangitis, plus liposomal amphotericin B, rituximab and adalimumab for specific indications.
noticias.accion: Context: suppliers of IUDs and elastography equipment may see higher demand from private providers.

noticias.titulo: Public consultation to replace the 2006 device reprocessing rules
noticias.resumen: ANVISA opened 120-day public consultations to replace RDC 156/2006 and Resolutions 2,605 and 2,606 on reprocessing of medical devices. The proposal moves to a risk- and evidence-based model with traceability, scientific validation of each cycle, new rules for third-party reprocessors and a periodically updated list of devices that cannot be reprocessed.
noticias.accion: If your devices are reprocessed in hospitals or you offer reprocessing services, review the draft and submit comments within the 120-day window.

noticias.titulo: Devices from three companies suspended after inspections
noticias.resumen: Resolutions RE 3,642, 3,643 and 3,644/2026 ordered recall and suspension of products from Mico Biomed do Brasil (molecular diagnostics), Healtech Saúde (21 dental and orthopedic products) and the Íonpro calibrator made by KDV, which has no operating authorization.
noticias.accion: Check whether you distribute or use any of the listed products and stop sales and use.

noticias.titulo: Updated manual for registering medical equipment and software
noticias.resumen: ANVISA released a new edition of its manual for regularizing medical equipment and software as a medical device, aligned with RDC 751/2022, RDC 657/2022 and RDC 848/2024. It covers classification, notification versus registration, labeling and safety requirements.
noticias.accion: Review the new manual before your next equipment or software submission to reduce deficiency letters.
